name: Rock Creek (Clinton)
blurb: Blue-ribbon creek east of Missoula with fast water and wood hazards. Seasonal boat-fishing restrictions and access closures require planning.

sections.notes: The Dalles boulder garden requires scouting for wood. FWP prohibits fishing from boats or vessels July 1–November 30; this is a fishing restriction, not a blanket prohibition on floating.
sections.accessReview: The launch label combines Bitterroot Flat and Dalles, which are different locations. This section needs a single confirmed put-in and landing before its mileage and timing can be offered.

notices.title: Seasonal boat-fishing restriction
notices.text: The 2026 FWP fishing regulations prohibit fishing from boats or vessels on this Rock Creek July 1–November 30. Check current fishing regulations and temporary closures before your trip.

notices.title: Valley of the Moon road-access closure
notices.text: Lolo National Forest Order 26-018-Lolo-D3 prohibits public motor-vehicle use of Gilbert Creek Road (Forest Road 34), mile 0–1.86, August 22–December 31, 2026 unless rescinded. Do not plan a vehicle shuttle across the Valley of the Moon bridge without checking the current order. This is a road closure, not a closure of the entire river.
notices.sourceName: US Forest Service — Gilbert Creek Road closure

sections.notes: Lower Rock Creek meets the Clark Fork. The take-out must be established before planning this section; no unmarked alternative is recommended.
sections.accessReview: The Valley of the Moon launch and a legal boat take-out near Clinton / the Clark Fork confluence remain unconfirmed. Do not treat the confluence as a guaranteed exit.
